evidence.title: Physical-Support Confidence Sets for Highly Coherent Dictionaries

summary: Researchers introduced a physical‑support confidence set framework that reliably quantifies uncertainty in highly coherent dictionaries used for sparse signal modeling. The technique improves the robustness of dictionary‑learning algorithms, enabling more accurate recovery in applications such as imaging and communications.
title: New Method Constructs Confidence Sets for Highly Coherent Dictionaries in Sparse Representation
